claims.claim: President Emmanuel Macron said Thursday that France would send soldiers, radar systems and defence systems to protect the Saudi port of Yanbu and would not join combat.
claims.episode_span: France will send soldiers, radar systems and defence systems to protect the Saudi oil port of Yanbu
claims.source_title: France to protect key Saudi oil terminal as Houthis step up missile attacks
claims.supporting_quote: “We are going to send military assets – that is soldiers, radar systems and defence systems – to protect the Yanbu site on the Red Sea,” Macron said, adding that the French military would not participate in combat.

claims.claim: Saudi Arabia said it intercepted missiles fired toward Yanbu and Taif.
claims.episode_span: Saudi Arabia said it intercepted missiles fired toward Yanbu and the city of Taif.
claims.source_title: France to protect key Saudi oil terminal as Houthis step up missile attacks
claims.supporting_quote: Saudi Arabia came under attack from the Houthi militia on Thursday, with the kingdom saying it intercepted missiles fired towards the Red Sea port of Yanbu and the city of Taif.

claims.claim: Saudi authorities reported intercepting six ballistic missiles, while the Houthis said they launched dozens of missiles and drones on Thursday.
claims.episode_span: Saudi authorities reported intercepting six ballistic missiles, while the Houthis said they launched dozens of missiles and drones on Thursday.
claims.source_title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan to convene urgent military meeting — Jerusalem Post
claims.supporting_quote: The Houthis said they launched dozens of missiles and drones at targets in Saudi Arabia on Thursday. Saudi authorities, for their part, reported intercepting six ballistic missiles fired by the group.

claims.claim: Saudi Arabia issued emergency warnings for Mecca, Jeddah and Yanbu.
claims.episode_span: The kingdom had issued emergency warnings for Mecca, Jeddah and Yanbu.
claims.source_title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan to convene urgent military meeting — Jerusalem Post
claims.supporting_quote: Earlier, the kingdom issued emergency warnings for areas including Mecca, Jeddah and Yanbu, Saudi Arabia’s main oil port on the Red Sea.

claims.claim: Saudi Arabia's foreign ministry said Friday that the kingdom, Turkey and Pakistan will hold an urgent chiefs-of-staff meeting to back Riyadh.
claims.episode_span: the kingdom, Turkey and Pakistan will hold an urgent meeting of their chiefs of staff on support for Riyadh
claims.supporting_quote: The Saudi foreign ministry announced on Friday that the kingdom, Turkey and Pakistan will hold an urgent meeting of their chiefs of staff to discuss ways to back Riyadh amid the escalating tensions with Yemen's Houthis.

claims.claim: The Saudi foreign ministry said the Mecca Agreement treats an attack on one party as an attack on all, and that the foreign ministers condemned attacks on Mecca and reaffirmed self-defense.
claims.episode_span: Under the Mecca Agreement, the ministry says an attack on one party is an attack on all.
claims.source_title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan to convene urgent military meeting — Jerusalem Post
claims.supporting_quote: According to a statement by the Saudi Foreign Ministry, the agreement provides that an attack on one of its parties is considered an attack on all participants.

claims.claim: Saudi Arabia's Grand Mufti called on the military to be ready to give their lives until the Houthis are removed from power.
claims.episode_span: Saudi Arabia's Grand Mufti called on the military to be ready to give their lives until the Houthis are removed from power
claims.source_title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan to convene urgent military meeting — Jerusalem Post
claims.supporting_quote: Saudi Arabia’s Grand Mufti called on the military to be ready to give their lives in the fight against the Houthis until the group is removed from power.

claims.claim: Master Sgt. Nadav Kali, 24, from Jerusalem, and Master Sgt. Ofek Moalem, 23, were killed after picking up an IDF drone that crashed at an outpost in northern Gaza and then detonated.
claims.episode_span: Master Sgt. Nadav Kali, 24, from Jerusalem, and Master Sgt. Ofek Moalem, 23, picked the drone up. It then detonated.
claims.source_title: Two reservists killed in northern Gaza as recovered IDF drone explodes
claims.supporting_quote: Master Sgt. Nadav Kali, 24, from Jerusalem, and 23-year-old Master Sgt. Ofek Moalem were killed after an IDF drone crashed at an IDF outpost in the northern Gaza Strip. They subsequently picked it up, at which point it detonated

claims.claim: Colombia's foreign ministry said Thursday it formally severed diplomatic relations with Iran, effective Saturday, citing security concerns, human rights violations, alleged terrorist links, the Hormuz blockade, attacks on uninvolved countries, and IAEA obstruction.
claims.episode_span: Colombia's foreign ministry said Thursday that the country has formally severed diplomatic relations with Iran, with the decision taking effect on Saturday.
claims.source_title: Colombia formally cuts ties with Iran
claims.supporting_quote: Colombia on Thursday announced that it formally severed diplomatic relations with Iran, citing it "deteriorated" in Tehran. The Foreign Ministry said the decision took effect on Saturday due to "national and hemispheric security concerns," accusing Iran of human rights violations as well as alleged links to international terrorist and narcoterrorist groups.
